title: Loss Prevention Managers
description: Plan and direct policies, procedures, or systems to prevent the loss of assets. Determine risk exposure or potential liability, and develop risk control measures.

tasks.text: Coordinate or conduct internal investigations of problems such as employee theft and violations of corporate loss prevention policies.
tasks.rationale: decision support — AI aids analysis, investigation is human-led

tasks.text: Administer systems and programs to reduce loss, maintain inventory control, or increase safety.
tasks.rationale: decision support — Security management needs accountability and situational judgment

tasks.text: Review loss prevention exception reports and cash discrepancies to ensure adherence to guidelines.
tasks.rationale: data analysis — Flags policy violations in records; human adjudicates

dwas.name: Examine financial records to ensure compliance with policies or regulations.
dwas.gwa_name: Evaluating Information to Determine Compliance with Standards

tasks.text: Train loss prevention staff, retail managers, or store employees on loss control and prevention measures.
tasks.rationale: interpersonal — Program design aided, delivery and engagement are human

tasks.text: Investigate or interview individuals suspected of shoplifting or internal theft.
tasks.rationale: interpersonal — Live interviewing is human relational work

dwas.name: Interview employees, customers, or others to collect information.

tasks.text: Provide recommendations and solutions in crisis situations such as workplace violence, protests, and demonstrations.
tasks.rationale: text generation — Response plans drafted; compliance review human

dwas.name: Develop emergency response plans or procedures.

tasks.text: Identify potential for loss and develop strategies to eliminate it.
tasks.rationale: decision support — Risk analysis aids; accountability-bearing judgment human

dwas.name: Analyze risks to minimize losses or damages.
Develop operating strategies, plans, or procedures.

tasks.text: Hire or supervise loss prevention staff.
tasks.rationale: interpersonal — Employee supervision is accountability-bearing human work

tasks.text: Advise retail managers on compliance with applicable codes, laws, regulations, or standards.
tasks.rationale: decision support — Compliance guidance drafted; human verifies and owns

dwas.name: Advise others on legal or regulatory compliance matters.
dwas.gwa_name: Providing Consultation and Advice to Others

tasks.text: Develop and maintain partnerships with federal, state, or local law enforcement agencies or members of the retail loss prevention community.
tasks.rationale: interpersonal — Interpersonal business relationships are inherently human

dwas.name: Establish interpersonal business relationships to facilitate work activities.

tasks.text: Perform or direct inventory investigations in response to shrink results outside of acceptable ranges.
tasks.rationale: decision support — Audit fieldwork and attestation remain human-owned

dwas.name: Conduct financial or regulatory audits.
dwas.gwa_name: Evaluating Information to Determine Compliance with Standards

tasks.text: Maintain documentation of all loss prevention activity.
tasks.rationale: data analysis — Maintain operational records in structured systems

tasks.text: Assess security needs across locations to ensure proper deployment of loss prevention resources, such as staff and technology.
tasks.rationale: decision support — Broad resource determination needs organizational judgment

tasks.text: Monitor compliance to operational, safety, or inventory control procedures, including physical security standards.
tasks.rationale: decision support — AI tracks regulatory compliance across documents

tasks.text: Verify correct use and maintenance of physical security systems, such as closed-circuit television, merchandise tags, and burglar alarms.
tasks.rationale: visual inspection — Physical condition/function check needs hands-on access

dwas.name: Inspect condition or functioning of facilities or equipment.

tasks.text: Visit stores to ensure compliance with company policies and procedures.
tasks.rationale: decision support — AI assesses compliance against written standards

dwas.name: Determine operational compliance with regulations or standards.

tasks.text: Analyze retail data to identify current or emerging trends in theft or fraud.
tasks.rationale: data analysis — Forecast analysis for decisions; human decides

dwas.name: Analyze forecasting data to improve business decisions.

tasks.text: Direct loss prevention audit programs including target store audits, maintenance audits, safety audits, or electronic article surveillance (EAS) audits.
tasks.rationale: decision support — Audit fieldwork and attestation remain human-owned

dwas.name: Conduct financial or regulatory audits.
dwas.gwa_name: Evaluating Information to Determine Compliance with Standards

tasks.text: Collaborate with law enforcement to investigate and solve external theft or fraud cases.
tasks.rationale: text generation — Drafting agency communications aided; relationships human

dwas.name: Communicate with government agencies.
dwas.gwa_name: Coordinating the Work and Activities of Others

tasks.text: Coordinate theft and fraud investigations involving career criminals or organized group activities.
tasks.rationale: decision support — Security management needs accountability and situational judgment

tasks.text: Supervise surveillance, detection, or criminal processing related to theft and criminal cases.
tasks.rationale: decision support — Security management needs accountability and situational judgment

tasks.rationale: data analysis — Cash flow tracking is digital and analyzable

tasks.rationale: data analysis — Procedure conformance monitoring is largely document and data based

dwas.name: Monitor organizational procedures to ensure proper functioning.

tasks.text: Advise retail establishments on development of loss-investigation procedures.
tasks.rationale: decision support — Drafts advice; accountability and context owned by human
